correctness.rationale: For the 5D Heisenberg Lie algebra H5(F_q), the central quotient V is a 4D nondegenerate alternating space. Subalgebras over an isotropic k-subspace have multiplicity 1+q^k, and over nonisotropic subspaces multiplicity 1; generation is equivalent to quotient subspace spanning V. Every triangle has one of the exhaustive dimension profiles (3,3,3),(1,3,3),(2,3,3),(2,2,3),(2,2,2). Hyperplane exclusion and complementary-plane counts give the first four terms. For (2,2,2), an ordered complementary pair has |GL2(F_q)|=(q²-1)(q²-q) choices for a third transverse plane; the isotropic triple correction uses exactly q²(q-1) invertible symmetric 2x2 matrices, valid in char 2 because ac=b² has q² solutions. The displayed weighted formula follows without overlap. Independently enumerated ALL 4D quotient subspaces in RREF and all weighted spanning triples for F2 and F3, giving 42,105 and 8,121,580, including profile totals; additionally evaluated q=4 formula to 425,816,170. General prime-power statement rests on the combinatorial argument, not finite enumeration.
